source_en: Home after a care home morning shift.
Back from nursing school.
Home to Grandma. Her pills are at noon.
Collecting my nursing pension. Thirty years.
Home to my parents' in the north.
Lecturing on why astrology is unscientific.
My papers. Sorry, I look tired. The energy in the ward is heavy.
I keep my documents in Grandma's prayer book. For protection.
Thank you. Sending you good energy for your shift.
Okay. Okay. I'm trusting the process. I'm trusting the process.
Can someone please check on Grandma? Her pills are at noon.
Grandma... please... someone take care of... Grandma...
It's all energy... it doesn't disappear... it just... changes...
Where are you coming from?
Care home shift, then nursing school. Now home to Grandma. Pills at noon.
The children's hospital, maternity ward. Newborns have such pure energy.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
Some fatigue. The ward is heavy. I meditate more to compensate.
Nothing. My hands are perfectly steady. Always have been. Look.
Good energy at this post today. I mean that literally, I can feel it.
Are you hydrated? You look dehydrated. The body always knows.
